abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions stretch to similar cases without flags — toSpeciesCards and the column-spec table are exactly right — but the per-page description-list markup and label fallbacks are copied, so an Items page 'shaped like Moves' starts as a paste.

findings.issue: The server keeps its own copy of the client route table (app/src/main.ts:14-21) to pick 200 vs 404; the two lists will drift when pages are added or removed and nothing flags the mismatch.
findings.suggestion: Derive both from one source of truth (e.g. a shared routes.ts consumed by the client, with the server importing or code-genning the path patterns from it), or at minimum add a cross-referencing comment in both files.

findings.issue: The effect fallback chain (English short_effect, whitespace-collapsed, else latest English flavor text, else em dash) is duplicated verbatim in app/src/pages/move.ts:11-14, so a change to Effect presentation means two edits.
findings.suggestion: Extract an englishEffect(effectEntries, flavorEntries) helper next to latestFlavorText in api.ts and use it from both pages (an Items-shaped page would reuse it too).

findings.issue: The badge-label fallback 'types.get(name) ?? humanize(name)' is repeated at move.ts:25, pokemon.ts:62 and pokemon.ts:296; a change to how type labels resolve needs three edits.
findings.suggestion: Add a typeLabel(name, names) helper (or make typeBadge accept the names map) in components.ts.

findings.issue: fact() (a dt/dd row) is local to move.ts while pokemon.ts:64-68 and types.ts:41-60 rebuild the same div/dt/dd shape by hand, so new Moves-shaped pages copy it.
findings.suggestion: Move fact()/a dl-row helper into dom.ts alongside section().

findings.issue: The home page hand-builds two cross-reference maps (pokemon-id -> types, pokemon-id -> generation) inline in the component, unlike the other aggregates which live in api.ts.
findings.suggestion: Move these into api.ts as named aggregates (e.g. typeIndex(), generationIndex()) so home.ts shrinks and the inversion logic is reusable/testable.

findings.issue: api.ts mixes four concerns — transport/cache, DTO interfaces, text helpers, and derived aggregates — in one module; fine at ~230 lines but it will grow with every new resource type.
findings.suggestion: Consider splitting text helpers (humanize, englishName, dexNumber) into a small text.ts so the data-client module stays focused on fetching.

summary: A clean, layered vanilla-TS SPA where the spec's cross-cutting rules (Pokémon cards, alternate-form exclusion, sprite URLs, caching) each live behind one narrow seam, so most bug fixes and the data-source change are one- or two-file edits. The main recurring edit cost is duplication: the route table exists in both main.ts and server.mjs, the effect-fallback and label-fallback logic are copied across pages, and the description-list markup has no shared helper. I'd merge on this with a note to extract those helpers before the next Moves-shaped page lands.
